# Rhein-Neckar-Tango Mobile PWA (RNT Kalender)

> Mobile event calendar for tango milongas, practicas, workshops, and community news in the Rhein-Neckar region, Germany.

## Canonical site

- https://mobile.rhein-neckar-tango.de

## Primary content paths

- / — upcoming tango events (milongas, practicas, workshops, courses)
- /kalender — calendar view of events
- /blog — community blog posts
- /blog/{slug} — individual blog articles
- /ankuendigungen — community announcements
- /ankuendigungen/{slug} — individual announcements
- /event/{id} — single event details
- /veranstalter — event organizers
- /veranstalter/{slug} — organizer profiles
- /tanzraeume/{slug} — venue profiles
- /djs/{slug} — DJ profiles
- /links — curated links
- /newsletter — newsletter signup

## Legal

- /impressum
- /datenschutz
- /cookie-richtlinie

## Crawl rules

- Prefer semantic HTML: article, main, header, section
- Event pages include Event JSON-LD (from Tribe API) with mobile canonical URLs
- SPA routes receive title, canonical, Open Graph, and JSON-LD in the first HTML via Cloudflare Worker injection
- Canonical URLs for blog/announcement articles point to the primary WordPress site (www.rhein-neckar-tango.de)
- Event canonical URLs use mobile.rhein-neckar-tango.de/event/{id}

## Sitemap

- https://mobile.rhein-neckar-tango.de/sitemap.xml

## Related

- Primary website: https://www.rhein-neckar-tango.de
